correctness.rationale: Claim has precise Pareto law, positive parameters, conditional normalized inverted parabolic profile and explicit scale equation. Equilibrium renewal age for delta>1 yields stationary mixture; substitution a=z y/c gives tail constant, edge exceedance and iff p<delta-1 moment cutoff. For 0<delta<1, exact renewal-age identity plus monotone-density Karamata yields Beta(1-delta,delta), whose convolution with TF gives the integral density and provable central |z|^{-delta} and edge (1-|z|)^{delta+1} coefficients. At delta=1 the renewal density is asymptotic to 1/log t, yielding log-age/log-time uniform; monotone scale and V !=0 a.s. transfer this to joint log edge and |position|. This is analytic proof, not an inference from 43 finite numerical checks; critical boundary, signs and constants checked.

originality.rationale: Against the source arXiv:2609.37110 and the strongest broader source arXiv:2509.06658, the finite-mean renewal mixture and the generic existence of power-law tails are **prior work**. Here the unreset propagator is the compact inverted Thomas–Fermi parabola with ballistic scale rather than Brownian Gaussian scaling. Explicit interacting-cloud coefficients and moment threshold, the Beta-aged central integrable divergence and nontrivial moving-edge exponent, and the marginal critical joint uniform logarithmic law were not found in the inspected material or deduplication ledger. value.rationale: Mesquita et al. explicitly identify non-Poisson resetting as a natural next direction. An exact finite vs infinite mean boundary changes the physics qualitatively: a stationary heavy-tailed condensate with exact moment cutoff, a linearly aging compact support distribution with divergent center and vanishing edge, and a marginal continuously varying logarithmic spatial scale. Sharp, parameter-dependent density and edge amplitudes answer concrete measurable questions in interacting Thomas-Fermi cold gas theory; not an arbitrary parameter slice. This coordinated singularity/phase picture differs quantitatively from known Brownian resetting and cannot be replaced by the generic renewal-mixture existence formula alone.
